change: **Hierarchical RL** (`hrl.py`, options framework): skills **SE** (enter, corners) and **SL** (loop) trained from C9, a **learned manager** (PPO over skills, decides every 0.53 s or at a pass) and a **fixed switch** baseline (enter until the first pass, then loop)
why: One flat policy traded corners against loops (loop practice: corners 67 % -> 57 %; corner reward: fewer loops). Separate skills don't have to trade
impact: pending: `results/hoop/hrl_compare.md` compares flat C9, the fixed switch and the learned manager on the optimiser's referee

change: **Optimiser fixes** (`loop_forever.py`): a new seed every round; every candidate re-scored on the same layouts with 72 laps episodes + 60 slanted starts; a challenger must win by **> 0.10**; score = laps/ep **+ 1.0 x oblique** (was 0.5); restarts at logon; one copy at a time (lock file)
why: Rounds 4 and 5 trained the *identical* run (seed 0 both times: both 2.155). One 36-episode number wobbles about +-0.15, so some "new best" calls were noise. Corners got worse while loops improved. The PC shutdown on 19 Oct killed the loop
impact: Fewer wasted rounds; corners now count as much as loops. Results from round 9 on are in the table below this one

change: **New ideas on top of C9**: CZ (line-up / clearance reward), CE (+ stress drone), CD (+ DAgger relabel), CL (lr 2e-5), CO (oblique starts 0.8)
why: C9 loops best but enters corners worst; these target corners (CZ, CO, CE), loops (CD) or stability (CL)
impact: CZ (round 9): no gain, oblique unchanged at 58 %, and it degraded late in training; more C9 training (seed 9) also lost (2.35 vs 2.75). Others pending
**2.33 laps/ep, 64 % 2+ passes, oblique 57 %**: the current best (`w10_mg6_C9_loop_practice`)

change: Optimiser round 3: **C9 = more slanted starts (0.6) + starts just before the hoop (0.3)**, from E9

change: Optimiser round 2: **E9 = stress drone** (`--stress-p 0.3`: 30 % of episodes with +0.06 s command delay and 2x drift), from O
why: The real drone clipped the hoop from the corners; a slower, driftier drone in training should teach earlier lining-up

impact: none beat the parent: DE9 2.06, OF 2.21, OS 2.06 vs C9 2.16-2.49; D9 crashed in round 1
